patches.before: button.onclick=()=>{if(child&&!child.closed){child.focus();return;}token=crypto.randomUUID();child=host.open(new URL('../documentation.html#'+token,import.meta.url),'frame-docs-'+token,'popup,width=760,height=700');if(!child)host.alert('Allow this documentation window to open, then click Docs again.');};
patches.after: button.onclick=()=>{if(child&&!child.closed){child.focus();return;}token=crypto.randomUUID();child=host.open(new URL('../documentation.html#'+token,import.meta.url),'frame-docs-'+token,documentationWindowFeatures(host));if(!child)host.alert('Allow this documentation window to open, then click Docs again.');};

Keep the draft open and retry the file operation.'),timeout);try{send(port,{kind:'seal',id:current.id,mode});}catch{abort('Docs connection failed. Keep the draft open and retry.');}});
patches.after: return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const current=seal={id:++next,port,child,epoch,close,resolve,reject};current.timer=setTimeout(()=>abort('Docs did not finish in time. Keep the draft open and retry the file operation.'),timeout);current.watch=setInterval(()=>{if(seal!==current||current.acknowledged)return;if(child!==current.child||port!==current.port){abort('Docs connection changed. Retry the file operation.');return;}if(!current.child.closed)return;seal=null;clearTimeout(current.timer);clearInterval(current.watch);current.close();current.resolve(null);},25);try{send(port,{kind:'seal',id:current.id,mode});}catch{abort('Docs connection failed. Keep the draft open and retry.');}});
